notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
If Devoted Druid has a +1/+1 counter on it, repeat from step 1 until Devoted Druid has no +1/+1 counters.
Activate Devoted Druid's outlast ability by paying {G} and tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Devoted Druid.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.
